elements.label: Mysterious documents
elements.description: A package of peculiar papers from my correspondent's executor. I must STUDY it, using either Passion or Reason.

slots.label: Approach
slots.description: Who am I? Will I use sensuality, discipline, passion, or money to get through this

elements.comment: similar to the bequest. Note that there are four study options. First three options are Health=Alpha Reason=Lambda Passion=Omega. If you choose funds you go down the evil path and it is quite different in gameplay.

elements.label: Retail Job
elements.description: A precarious position as a cart pusher. Miserable, but it's all you can find just now.

elements.label: Notes on a Possible Collaborator
elements.description: My correspondent had recorded his observations of me. He believed I had 'potential'. He recorded his observations of someone else, too. With time and study, perhaps I can find that person.

elements.label: Order of the Guiding Palm

slots.label: Associate
slots.description: A new recruit, or a hardened disciple.

slots.label: Ceremony
slots.description: For the higher mysteries, deeper oaths are needed.

slots.label: Trappings
slots.description: For a proper sense of occasion. Consumes Ingredients and Influences; uses, but does not consume, Tools.

elements.description: An occult society dedicated to the study of the invisible hand and capital. [Guiding Palm, unusually, allows you to use any aspect to promote Believers.]
